components.name: Pumpkin Layer
directions: Beat eggs, sugars, flour, pie spice, and salt until smooth.
Mix in pumpkin. Gradually beat in milk.
Bake at 425°F for 10 minutes, then reduce temperature to 350°F and bake 15 more minutes.

components.name: Pecan Topping
directions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add corn syrup, brown sugar, molasses, flour, vanilla, and salt.
Sprinkle with chopped pecans and cover with pecan halves.
Bake at 350°F for 30–35 minutes or until set.
Cool completely. Store in the refrigerator.
